_comment: One published jar per group, built from the group's first version (the lead) and declaring exactly the listed
Minecraft versions in fabric.mod.json. A version may only be listed if (1) its own build compiles to classes
byte-identical to the lead's (verifyGroupClasses) and (2) the lead's staged jar passes smokeTest on it.
Every member compiles at the lead's Java level so the comparison is exact. Never list an untested version.
